23894-billie-bradley-at-three-towers-hal.title: Or, Leading a Needed Rebellion
23894-billie-bradley-at-three-towers-hal.creator: Janet D. Wheeler
23894-billie-bradley-at-three-towers-hal.description: A book by Janet D. Wheeler. oys and girls looked queer--almost ghostly. They were gathered about a shabby old trunk, and beside this trunk a man was kneeling. As Billie Bradley spoke, the man, who was her father, rose to his feet and thoughtfully brushed the dust from his clothes. Then he stood looking down at the hundreds and hundreds of postage stamps and old coins that filled the queer old trunk.

69332-les-beaux-messieurs-de-bois-dore-v.title: Les Beaux Messieurs De Bois Dore Vol 2 Of 2
69332-les-beaux-messieurs-de-bois-dore-v.creator: Unknown
69332-les-beaux-messieurs-de-bois-dore-v.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. At first the old Celadon submitted to the beautifying process in profound secrecy, at the time when the child left his room for his first play. But, as Mario asked no embarrassing or impertinent questions, the old man gradually relaxed his great precautions, and proceeded to his daily rejuvenation with most ingenuous explanations.

arxiv-1811-03204.title: An Efficient Algorithm for High-Dimensional Log-Concave Maximum Likelihood
arxiv-1811-03204.creator: Brian Axelrod, Gregory Valiant
arxiv-1811-03204.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Brian Axelrod, Gregory Valiant. The log-concave maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) problem answers: for a set of points X 1 , … ​ X n ∈ ℝ d X_{1},...X_{n}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , which log-concave density maximizes their likelihood?

arxiv-2106-09062.title: Local well-posedness for the Boltzmann equation with very soft potential and polynomially decaying initial data
arxiv-2106-09062.creator: Christopher Henderson, Weinan Wang
arxiv-2106-09062.description: Abstract . In this paper, we address the local well-posedness of the spatially inhomogeneous non-cutoff Boltzmann equation when the initial data decays polynomially in the velocity variable. We consider the case of very soft potentials γ + 2 ​ s < 0 \gamma+2s<0 .

arxiv-2112-10553.title: Training dataset and dictionary sizes matter in BERT models: the case of Baltic languages
arxiv-2112-10553.creator: Matej Ulčar, Marko Robnik-Šikonja
arxiv-2112-10553.description: Abstract Large pretrained masked language models have become state-of-the-art solutions for many NLP problems. While studies have shown that monolingual models produce better results than multilingual models, the training datasets must be sufficiently large. We trained a trilingual LitLat BERT-like model for Lithuanian, Latvian, and English, and a monolingual Est-RoBERTa model for Estonian.

arxiv-2204-07511.title: Implication of the W W boson mass anomaly at CDF II in the Higgs triplet model with a mass difference
arxiv-2204-07511.creator: Shinya Kanemura, Kei Yagyu
arxiv-2204-07511.description: Abstract A new report for the measurement of the W boson mass has been provided by the CDF II experiment. The measured value of the W boson mass is given to be m W CDF II = 80.4335 ± 0.0094 m_{W}^{\text{CDF II}}=80.4335\pm 0.

arxiv-2405-15410.title: Electric Hall Effect and Quantum Electric Hall Effect
arxiv-2405-15410.creator: Chaoxi Cui, Run-Wu Zhang, Yilin Han, Zhi-Ming Yu, Yugui Yao
arxiv-2405-15410.description: Abstract Exploring new Hall effect is always a fascinating research topic. The ordinary Hall effect and the quantum Hall effect, initially discovered in two-dimensional (2D) non-magnetic systems, are the phenomena that a transverse current is generated when a system carrying an electron current is placed in a magnetic field perpendicular to the currents.

arxiv-2407-15166.title: Adversarial Circuit Evaluation
arxiv-2407-15166.creator: Niels uit de Bos, Adrià Garriga-Alonso
arxiv-2407-15166.description: Abstract Circuits are supposed to accurately describe how a neural network performs a specific task, but do they really? We evaluate three circuits found in the literature (IOI, greater-than, and docstring) in an adversarial manner, considering inputs where the circuit’s behavior maximally diverges from the full model.

arxiv-2503-00547.title: Performance Heterogeneity in Graph Neural Networks: Lessons for Architecture Design and Preprocessing
arxiv-2503-00547.creator: \name Lukas Fesser \email lukas_fesser@fas.harvard.edu
arxiv-2503-00547.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks have emerged as the most popular architecture for graph-level learning, including graph classification and regression tasks, which frequently arise in areas such as biochemistry and drug discovery. Achieving good performance in practice requires careful model design.

arxiv-2510-24471.title: Forward Convolutive Prediction for Frame Online Monaural Speech Dereverberation Based on Kronecker Product Decomposition
arxiv-2510-24471.creator: Yujie Zhu 1 , Jilu Jin 2 , Xueqin Luo 2 , Wenxing Yang 3 , Zhong-Qiu Wang 4 , Gongping Huang 1 , Jingdong Chen 2 , and Jacob Benesty 5
arxiv-2510-24471.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yujie Zhu 1 , Jilu Jin 2 , Xueqin Luo 2 , Wenxing Yang 3 , Zhong-Qiu Wang 4 , Gongping Huang 1 , Jingdong Chen 2 , and Jacob Benesty 5. Dereverberation has long been a crucial research topic in speech processing, aiming to alleviate the adverse effects of reverberation in voice communication and speech interaction systems. Among existing approaches, forward convolutional prediction (FCP) has recently attracted attention.

arxiv-2602-16182.title: World Model Failure Classification and Anomaly Detection for Autonomous Inspection
arxiv-2602-16182.creator: Michelle Ho, Muhammad Fadhil Ginting, Isaac R. Ward, Andrzej Reinke, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Ali-akbar Agha-Mohammadi, Shayegan Omidshafiei
arxiv-2602-16182.description: Abstract Autonomous inspection robots for monitoring industrial sites can reduce costs and risks associated with human-led inspection. However, accurate readings can be challenging due to occlusions, limited viewpoints, or unexpected environmental conditions. We propose a hybrid framework that combines supervised failure classification with anomaly detection, enabling classification of inspection tasks as a success, known failure, or anomaly (i.e., out-of-distribution) case.

Under this power an order of council, dated the 5th of February 1876, was made, whereby the circuit system was remodelled.

pmc-10682224.title: Cell death induction and intracellular vesicle formation in human colorectal cancer cells treated with Δ9-Tetrahydrocannabinol
pmc-10682224.creator: Yu-Na Hwang, In-Seo Kwon, Ju-Hee Park, Han-Heom Na, Tae-Hyung Kwon, Jin-Sung Park, Keun-Cheol Kim
pmc-10682224.description: BackgroundΔ9-Tetrahydrocannabinol (Δ9-THC) is a principal psychoactive extract of Cannabis sativa and has been traditionally used as palliative medicine for neuropathic pain. Cannabidiol (CBD), an extract of hemp species, has recently attracted increased attention as a cancer treatment, but Δ9-THC is also requiring explored pharmacological application.ObjectiveThis study evaluated the pharmacological effects of Δ9-THC in two human colorectal cancer cell lines.

pmc-11475481.title: Transcutaneous Electrical Acupoint Stimulation for Elders with Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment: A Randomized Controlled Pilot and Feasibility Trial
pmc-11475481.creator: Wenjing Xu, Zichun Ding, Heng Weng, Junyu Chen, Wenjing Tu, Yulei Song, Yamei Bai, Shuxia Yan, Guihua Xu, Grigorios Nasios
pmc-11475481.description: Background: Amnestic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI) is an important window of opportunity for early intervention and rehabilitation in dementia. The aim of this study was to investigate the feasibility and effect of delivering transcutaneous electrical acupuncture stimulation (TEAS) intervention to elders with aMCI.

pmc-12385620.title: Liupao Tea Extract Alleviates Rheumatoid Arthritis in Mice by Regulating the Gut–Joint Axis Mediated via Fatty Acid Metabolism
pmc-12385620.creator: Ying Tong, Zhiyong She, Xueting Lin, Jichu Luo, Xuan Guan, Mingsen Wen, Li Huang, Bao Yang, Xiaoying Liang, Song Xu, Yuru Tan, Pingchuan Zhu, Zhaoyang Wei, Haidan Liu, Xiadan Liu, Qisong Zhang
pmc-12385620.description: As a highly disabling chronic inflammatory disease, rheumatoid arthritis (RA) necessitates novel interventions. Liupao tea is a traditional Chinese dark tea known for its favorable anti-inflammatory properties. This study aims to elucidate the active ingredients and action mechanisms underlying the therapeutic effects of Liupao tea extract (LPTE) in RA. LPTE was preliminarily characterized by LC-MS technology.

pmc-12658881.title: Evaluating the Types of Performance Monitoring Used in Private Chartered Universities in Uganda: A Mixed-Methods
pmc-12658881.creator: Turyamureeba silaji, Zulaihatu Lawal Bagiwa, Tukur Muhammad, Issah Iddrisu, Issah Iddrisu, M Mukhibat Syaufa, Turyamureeba silaji, M Mukhibat Syaufa, Turyamureeba silaji, Turyamureeba silaji
pmc-12658881.description: BackgroundPerformance monitoring is essential for enhancing academic staff productivity and institutional accountability in higher education. In Uganda, private chartered universities face challenges in implementing effective performance monitoring systems. This study examines the types and effectiveness of these systems in private chartered universities in Western Uganda.MethodsThe study was guided by Fayol’s Administrative Management Theory and Vroom’s Expectancy Theory.

pmc-13315387.title: Eye Loss, Orbital Sequelae, and Prosthetic Rehabilitation Following Crowd-Control Kinetic Impact Projectile Injuries: The Largest Civilian Cohort
pmc-13315387.creator: Sebastián Córdova, Miguel Ángel Campos, Carmen Torres, Patricio Bustamante, Eric Tapia, Joaquín Varas, Macarena Mesa, Cesar Silva, José Luis Sanhueza
pmc-13315387.description: IntroductionDuring the 2019–2020 Chilean social unrest, massive police use of kinetic impact projectiles (KIPs) caused unprecedented severe ocular traumas, initially affecting over 460 individuals. We examined the largest civilian cohort with complete globe loss to characterize orbital/peri-orbital sequelae, analyze projectile-specific injury patterns, and assess factors affecting rehabilitation.

pmc-13358199.title: Rethinking Circular Hospital Design: A Systematic Review
pmc-13358199.creator: Ramkrishna Mondal
pmc-13358199.description: Why are most hospitals or buildings of a rectangular design only? Compared to the standard rectangular Nightingale nursing unit design, why has a circular/elliptical nursing unit or hospital design not been developed to date? This study reexamines the concept of circular hospital building design.

pmc-13498617.title: Building the adult growth hormone deficiency data mart: a Real-World model of AI-driven clinical data extraction in a single Italian center
pmc-13498617.creator: Edoardo Vergani, Chiara Iacomini, Antonella Giampietro, Domenico Milardi, Sabrina Chiloiro, Antonio Mancini, Laura De Marinis, Antonio Bianchi, Stefano Patarnello, Alfredo Pontecorvi
pmc-13498617.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeAdult Growth Hormone Deficiency (AGHD) is a complex and under-recognized condition, mainly managed in outpatient settings and characterized by fragmented and heterogeneous clinical data. Population registries provide high-quality evidence but require long timeframes and substantial resources.
